name: Process / How-To Essay
purpose: Lets the reader actually perform a procedure by walking through it in the order it must happen.

components.note: Omit when the process needs nothing beyond what the reader already has.
States the result achieved, not just 'you're done.'

pitfalls: A skipped step the reader can't recover from without outside knowledge.
Steps given out of true dependency order.
A warning placed after the step it would have prevented a mistake on.
